name: keyboard-portrait
steps: (async()=>{await document.fonts.ready;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(document.querySelector('.talk-log__list'))return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}throw Error('Talk not ready')})()

const p=document.querySelector('.desktop-typing .picture-surface').getBoundingClientRect(); if(p.height<50||p.top<0||p.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Destination picture out of view'); const t=document.querySelector('.remote-keyboard textarea').getBoundingClientRect();if(t.top<0||t.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Text out of view');const c=document.querySelector('.desktop-typing__composer').getBoundingClientRect();if(t.top<c.top-1||t.bottom>c.bottom+1)throw Error('Text clipped by composer');

name: text-refused
steps: (async()=>{await document.fonts.ready;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(document.querySelector('.talk-log__list'))return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}throw Error('Talk not ready')})()

const t=document.querySelector('.remote-keyboard textarea');if(t.value!=='Café déjà')throw Error('Lost refused text');const c=document.querySelector('.desktop-typing__composer').getBoundingClientRect(),r=t.getBoundingClientRect(),b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Paste instead').getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<c.top||b.bottom>c.bottom||r.bottom>c.bottom)throw Error('Text and Paste must be visible together');
